description: This file defines the EntityId interface, representing an immutable identifier for entities within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends CharSequence and Comparable, providing default implementations for some CharSequence methods and a custom comparison method, along with an abstract method to determine if the ID is a dummy.

classes.name: EntityId
classes.description: An interface representing a unique, immutable identifier for entities in the model, providing methods for comparison, subsequences, length, character access, and checking for dummy IDs.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the EntityId based on its String representation, as a default implementation.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index in the EntityId's String representation.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the EntityId's String representation between start and end indices.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this EntityId with another based on their String representations.

methods.name: isDummy
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if this EntityId is a dummy ID.
